selection_rule: Hand-written before Task 5 analysis; every concept is an exact string retained by at least one trained temporal CBM model.
notes: Expected signs are preregistered directional checks, not fitted parameters.
CREMA-D breathiness uses the available eGeMAPSv02 HNRdBACF functional.
No speech-rate mapping is included because the prepared descriptor cache has no speech-rate descriptor.

mappings.rationale: Higher vocal pitch should correspond to higher median F0.
Lower vocal pitch should correspond to lower median F0.

mappings.concept: a voice with high mean loudness
mappings.rationale: Higher loudness should correspond to higher RMS level.
Lower loudness should correspond to lower RMS level.
Breathy phonation is expected to have lower harmonic-to-noise ratio.
Sharper attacks should produce stronger onset peaks.

mappings.concept: a voice with bright timbre with high harmonic content
mappings.rationale: The selected descriptor operationalizes harmonic content, not brightness alone.
Higher pitch should correspond to higher median F0 when voiced.
Lower pitch should correspond to lower median F0 when voiced.
Broadband content should have wider spectral bandwidth.
Impulsive sounds should have stronger onset peaks.
Tonal sounds should retain more harmonic energy.
Harmonic sounds should retain more harmonic energy.
Narrow-band content should have smaller spectral bandwidth.
An impulsive transient should have a stronger onset peak.
Sharp attacks should produce stronger onset peaks.
Lower pitch should correspond to lower median F0 when voiced.
